test_WikiannTest: test the WikiannTest class that extends tfds.testing.DatasetBuilderTestCase for the wikiann dataset
test_WikiannTest_config: test the wikiann dataset builder with the 'en' config specified in BUILDER_CONFIG_NAMES_TO_TEST
test_WikiannTest_splits: test the wikiann dataset splits with 3 train, 1 validation, and 1 fake test example
test_WikiannTest_dataset_class: test the wikiann.Wikiann dataset class referenced by DATASET_CLASS in WikiannTest
run_test_main: run tfds.testing.test_main() to execute the WikiannTest test suite from the command line
